model.translation_command_order: base_motion[0] -> anchor +y slide joint, base_motion[1] -> anchor +x slide joint

model_form: joint velocity = sign(u) * max(gain*|u| - deadband, 0) per slide joint (anchor frame) and for yaw

provenance.translation: floating_legged_base.xml: velocity actuators kv=1000 (ctrlrange +/-1 m/s), joint frictionloss=250 N -> static friction overcome only when kv*u > 250, i.e. |u| > 0.25; steady state v ~= u - 0.25. Consistent with calibrate_base_action.py (u=0.3 -> 0.046-0.05 m/s) and calibrate_base_response.py.
provenance.yaw: least-squares fit to calibrate_base_response.py steady yaw rates (u=0.2..1.0): v ~= 1.502*u - 0.168 rad/s
provenance.frame_and_offset: calibrate_base_action.py: commands are anchor-frame [y, x] slide velocities (heading independent to 3e-4); yaw axis offset from the base centre site fitted from yaw-induced site motion

frame_calibration.units: m/s or rad/s per unit of normalized base_motion command
